methodology.baseline: Version 4, existing command and plane candidates, production flate2 level 3
methodology.candidate: Version 5, same fitting and compressor, compact field candidates added
methodology.content: Complete stored excerpts with unchanged seek boundaries and exact encoded audio payloads; all-tier excerpt contains first three shared chunks, ending at 250000 microseconds
methodology.concurrency: One benchmark process at a time; no concurrent encoding or rendering jobs. CPU frequency and other host activity were not controlled.
methodology.transferredMediaBytes: Header, actual metadata, full index, selected rendition and audio body bytes. Excludes HTTP headers, decoder assets and unrequested padding.
limitations: Four 1080p excerpts span only 2 through 4.004 seconds.
Each all-tier case spans only 0.25 seconds and 15 source events.
No controlled ingestion-speed or hardware energy comparison.
Exact equality is against existing ASCII output, not source video.

sources.name: all-tiers
sources.source: first three shared chunks of retained 120-second all-tier archive

initialFailedGate.reason: Raster-wide scatter writes and repeated geometry validation caused a 42.7 percent median cell-decoding regression on fossils.
initialFailedGate.resolution: Gather attributes into a hot composition, specialize prediction modes, validate geometry once and construct followers from validated origins.

methodology.comparison: Version 5 versus version 6, same fitted scene-v1 ASCII cells, full RGB precision, presentation durations, encoded audio, seek boundaries and production level-3 zlib-rs compressor.
methodology.corpus: Four complete 1080p excerpts: cartoon 96 events in 4.004 seconds; fossils 96 events in four seconds; weave 240 events in four seconds; detail 120 events in two seconds.
methodology.decode: One warmup and five alternating measured passes per output mode. Exact full output, presentation and audio hashes required. Timed decoding excludes transport, initialization, hashing and visible presentation.
methodology.encoding: One warmup and three alternating measured complete 360p encodes. Every pixel and presentation time must match; audio is validated. Encoding comparison does not require identical encoded-audio bytes.
methodology.concurrency: Final benchmarks ran one at a time without other owned tests, compiles, rendering jobs or conversions. Existing user applications remained running.
methodology.affinity: Decoder comparisons and initial encoding comparisons were not pinned. Large encoder variation prompted a second complete comparison on physical performance cores 0, 2, 4 and 6. Frequency and governor were unchanged; other applications were not isolated.
methodology.sizes: Requested media bodies include audio, header, actual metadata and full index. Excludes HTTP headers, decoder assets and unrequested padding. Complete file sizes are separately retained.
limitations: Short complete excerpts do not establish sustained playback or performance on every device.
No original-source fidelity change. Exact agreement is with existing ASCII output.
No real-time encoding or stable general encoding-speed improvement established.
No energy measurement or commercial patent clearance.

initialFailedDecoder.reason: Per-field green-channel lookup and repeated color transformation caused large decoding regressions.

subsequentFailedDecoders.implementation: Grouped RGB reference transformation and complete field loop; some p95 gates fail.
Direct correction against RGB references; complete field loop still causes a 5.65 percent fossils cell median regression.

finalDecoder.implementation: Gather only the validated active attribute prefix. Correct color residuals directly against RGB references without copying and transforming a reference cell.

encoding.interpretation: Unpinned wall times vary substantially, including a 60.71 percent fossils median increase. Pinning both binaries to the same physical performance cores yields 2.91 percent and 5.40 percent median increases. No encoding-speed win is claimed. The 360p archives are 0.99 percent and 3.49 percent smaller.

sustainedPlayback.scope: The first 106 shared chunks, 602 events and 10.033 seconds at every tier. Trials request ten source seconds, three times per tier at 2x, with fixed manual quality and the default CPU renderer. This is a single candidate playback audit, not a paired performance comparison with the earlier version.
sustainedPlayback.repackWallTime: Diagnostic only; correctness tests and builds ran concurrently.

sustainedPlayback.interpretation: Every tier reached its requested source frontier. Only 360p passed every uninterrupted trial. 480p stalled once; 720p and 1080p stalled in all trials. The all-tier maximum-speed target remains unmet.
sustainedPlayback.failure: Sustained playback stalled or failed to consume the source timeline at the requested speed.

decodingDiagnostics.method: Node V8 CPU sampling at the default 1000 microsecond interval. The playback benchmark decodes the first 60 source events with cell output, one warmup and five measured passes. Sampling includes warmup, initialization and harness work such as CRC, output hashing and file reads. Diagnostic only, not a comparative speed result or full browser profile.
